title: Q6–7: Phản hồi Email Lịch Đào tạo Nhân viên Mới
passage:
Dear New Team Member,

We are excited to welcome you to BrightPath Consulting! Our mandatory half-day orientation will take place this Friday, May 9, from 9:00 A.M. to 12:30 P.M. in Conference Room 4B.

During the session, we will distribute your company laptops, review health-benefit options, and introduce you to your department mentors. A complimentary buffet lunch will be served right afterward. Please reply to this message if you have any questions or special requests before Friday.

Best regards,
Elena Morales
instructions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a newly hired employee. In your e-mail, ask TWO questions about the orientation and make ONE special request.
checklist: Hỏi 2 câu hỏi cụ thể liên quan đến buổi định hướng (VD: tài liệu cần mang theo, chỗ đỗ xe, hoặc phần mềm cần cài sẵn)
Đưa ra 1 yêu cầu đặc biệt rõ ràng (VD: suất ăn chay/không dị ứng cho bữa trưa buffet hoặc hỗ trợ thiết bị)

title: Q6–7: Phản hồi Xác nhận Đơn hàng Thiếu Thiết bị Văn phòng
passage:

Our delivery records show that your order #ND-7741 (six ergonomic desk chairs and two oak bookcases) was delivered to your office earlier today.

We strive to provide flawless commercial service. Please let us know if everything arrived in satisfactory condition or if our support team can assist you with anything further.

Sincerely,

emailMeta.subject: Final Speaker Schedule — Pacific Tech Forum (September 4)

passage:
Dear Speakers,

Thank you for agreeing to present at the Pacific Tech Forum on September 4. Your 30-minute presentation has been tentatively assigned to the 9:30 A.M. slot in Grand Hall B.

Warm regards,
David Park

title: Q6–7: Phản hồi Thông báo Bảo trì Bãi đỗ xe Tòa nhà

emailMeta.subject: Underground Garage Resurfacing — June 10 to June 12

passage:
Dear Tenants,

From Tuesday, June 10, through Thursday, June 12, Levels B1 and B2 of the underground parking garage will be closed for concrete resurfacing.

No vehicles may remain in the garage during these three days. We are currently arranging discounted parking vouchers at a nearby public lot for affected employees. Please contact our office with your company's needs and any operational concerns by Friday, June 6.

Regards,
Property Management Office
instructions: Respond to the e-mail as the Operations Coordinator of a tenant company with 25 staff members. In your e-mail, give ONE piece of information about your company's needs, ask TWO questions about the temporary parking arrangement.
checklist: Cung cấp 1 thông tin cụ thể về nhu cầu của công ty bạn (VD: số lượng thẻ gửi xe cần cho nhân viên hoặc lịch xe tải giao hàng cần bốc dỡ)

title: Q6–7: Phản hồi Thư Mời Phỏng vấn (Xin đổi lịch & Hỏi thông tin)
passage:
Dear Applicant,

We were very impressed by your résumé and would like to invite you to an in-person interview for the Business Analyst role at our downtown office on Thursday, March 13, at 10:30 A.M.

The interview will include a panel discussion with two department managers. Please reply to confirm whether this time works for you and let us know if you need any additional information to prepare.

Best regards,
Marcus Reed

emailMeta.subject: Upcoming Annual Renewal Notice — CloudMetrics Enterprise Plan

passage:
Dear IT Procurement Manager,

Your company's annual CloudMetrics Enterprise subscription (40 user seats) is set to renew automatically on December 1. Please note that our updated pricing will take effect at renewal, increasing the annual rate from $12,000 to $14,400 due to new AI forecasting features.

If you wish to modify your seat count, disable auto-renewal, or discuss multi-year pricing options, please contact our renewals desk before November 20.

Kind regards,
CloudMetrics Renewals Team
instructions: Respond to CloudMetrics as the IT Procurement Manager. In your e-mail, express ONE concern about the price increase, propose ONE compromise or alternative option, and request ONE specific action before November 20.
checklist: Bày tỏ 1 quan ngại thẳng thắn nhưng lịch sự về mức tăng 20% ($12,000 → $14,400), đặc biệt nếu công ty chưa dùng hết tính năng AI mới

passage:
Dear Partnerships Director,

West Coast University will host its Annual Engineering & Tech Career Fair on April 11, attracting over 800 graduating seniors and graduate students. We would be honored to feature your company as a Gold Sponsor ($3,500), which includes a prime double booth, logo placement on all event banners, and early access to our digital résumé database.

Please let us know if your organization would like to participate and whether you have any questions about sponsorship packages.

Sincerely,
Prof. Rachel Bennett
